protocol.sizing: fixed EUR 500 upside, balance-sensitive downside; quote-currency conversion at entry/exit
protocol.execution: closed-candle signals, next-M1 entry, bid/ask prices, conservative SL-first OHLC ambiguity

acceptance.nominal: entries>=40, validation entries>=12, entry win rate>50%, PF>=1.10, positive train and validation, >=50% positive weeks in both, drawdown<=12R
acceptance.stress: spread x1.25; entries>=35, validation entries>=10, entry win rate>50%, PF>=1.05, positive train and validation, >=40% positive weeks in both, drawdown<=12R

limitations: The complete period is already-inspected development data, not a fresh holdout.
Five profiles per session is a capacity ceiling; no failing profile is added to fill a quota.
Candle replay uses conservative SL-first M1 ambiguity and does not model gaps, financing or broker minimum distances.
Partial runners are research proxies and require separate live execution work before implementation.
